premium_title:
⭐ Premium

Benefits:
• More than {free_limit} active alerts (inactive unlimited)
• Alert types beyond live start (category / upcoming / stream end)
• Twitch follow auto-sync
• Advanced mode (ignore keywords, delayed send, repeat mute, delete previous bot messages)
• Publish schedule to Twitch
• Alert history for 60 days (7 days on free)
• Restore deleted subscriptions from cart for 30 days (10 on free)
• Unlimited Twitch stream chat in the Mini App
• Premium channel for streamers — free bot interactions for users, always in What to watch when matching, recommended to new users

How to get:
• Pay for a subscription (buttons below), or
• Active Twitch subscription to https://www.twitch.tv/{channel}, or
• Streamers: one-time Premium channel purchase

channel_setup:
Add the bot to the channel as an admin with posting rights.

Then send the channel @username or forward a message from the channel.
group_setup:
Add the bot to the group or community.

Bot permissions:
• Send messages (required)
• Delete own messages (for “delete old”)
• Admin is not required if members can post

Send one of:
• Topic link: https://t.me/c/name/30
• Group @username (no topic — general chat)
• Group ID (e.g. -1001234567890)
• Forwarded message from the group (must say «Forwarded from: …», not from DM)

For groups with topics, a topic link is the most reliable option.
delete_old_text:
Delete the bot's previous message when a new stream starts?

If enabled, the bot deletes its last message in this chat before sending a new one.
In channels and groups the bot needs permission to delete its own messages.
Telegram allows deleting only messages younger than ~48 hours.
delete_old_text_category:
Delete the bot's previous category-change message when the category changes again?

By default only category-change alerts are deleted — other bot notifications are left alone.
In channels and groups the bot needs permission to delete its own messages.
Telegram allows deleting only messages younger than ~48 hours.
